# V3.46 content: Haohuang's gatekeeping dialogue on Blood Peak, his boss fight,
# the placeholder Great Verdant King behind him, and the 贪婪 ω special.
# Glossary anchors used: 昊荒 = Haohuang, 纳可 = Neko, 破败之域 = Ruined Domain,
# 声律城 = Shenglü City, 圣荒城 = Shenghuang City, 领 = Fief (燕岗领 = Yangang
# Fief), 秘境 = Secret Realm, 血洛晶 = Bloodfall Crystal, 鲜红 = Bright-Red,
# 水晶 = Crystal, 大青王尤斯纳 = Great Verdant King Yusna, 精血 = blood-essence.
# Row 12 must split into the same four chunks as the Chinese - text, text,
# span body, tail - or add_chunk pairs the wrong halves. Its second chunk ends
# in a colon rather than a word: the chunk boundary is a text-node boundary and
# add_chunk strips each side, so a trailing space there would not survive to
# the page and the formula would render glued to "divided by".

column2:
[Haohuang] Heh. If it isn't the little girl who stood outside Shenglü City watching that fight, scared out of her wits.
I'll say it one more time: 【Ruined Domain】 is no place for you!
My superior's orders were strict — let a single person through and I forfeit half my estate!

[Haohuang] Anyone else and I'd have waved them through long ago.
But you, Neko……
Five fiefs in every direction, and who doesn't know that wherever you go you bring the whole family along!
Sending family members off to explore the Secret Realms!
And then an entire fief's Secret Realms are swept clean!!
If I let you in, the fine would run to thousands of Bloodfall Crystals!
Selling me off wouldn't cover it! Guaaaaah!
Then……shall the two of us give it a try?

[Haohuang] You want a fight? Then fight!
I have six Bright-Red Crystals at my back!
I am invincible!

Over these years in Shenghuang City he tempered a will like iron. Faced with the money that once left him utterly powerless, he will now only go a little easy on you. It is absolutely not the case that letting Neko past would leave him penniless.
[WIP] Not finished yet. You had better not kill it.
Even beating him won't get you into the Ruined Domain. His superior — the Great Verdant King — is still in the way, after all.
[WIP] If you cheat this thing to death in 3.46, your save is done for. Just start another run and unlock 4-6.
You've gained the ability to 【Refine Blood-Essence】! [WIP/coming in V3.47]

This enemy seems very sensitive to money.
Enemy damage is divided by:(1 + √(character money/${format_money(enemy.spec_value[70])}) )
